note: Every foreground and background pair the components use, checked in all three themes by `pnpm check:contrast`. Text needs 4.5:1 (3:1 only for 24px+ or bold 19px+ text). Control edges, focus outlines, and meaningful icons need 3:1. When a component puts a color on a new background, add the pair here.
